description: Construct TemplateService in the composition root and make template management reachable from the operator UI. Build TemplateService in PresenterIntegration with an <AppBase>\Templates persistence folder, inject it into OperatorWindow via SetServices, and add a 'Templates' entry to the Tools dropdown that opens TemplateManagerPanel in a dialog window (mirroring ToolSearch_Click). After this feature the user can open Tools -> Templates and see the 3 built-in templates (Default Centered, Lower Third, Trendy Line) plus any custom ones, and Duplicate/Delete work (those already call the service). Built-in seeding needs NO new code: TemplateService.EnsureLoadedAsync already seeds and de-dupes by Id. This feature is a prerequisite for FEAT-002.
steps: In WorshipPlayer.Presenter\Views\OperatorWindow.xaml.cs, add a private field 'private ITemplateService? _templateService;' alongside the other service fields (~L90-98). The using 'WorshipPlayer.Core.Services.Interfaces' is already present.

In the same file, add an 'ITemplateService? templateService' parameter as the LAST parameter of SetServices (declaration at ~L473) and assign '_templateService = templateService;' in the method body (~L485-497).

In WorshipPlayer.UI\Services\PresenterIntegration.cs, add a public property 'public ITemplateService TemplateService { get; }' to the 'Additional services' property group (~L44-52). Usings 'WorshipPlayer.Presenter.Services' and 'WorshipPlayer.Core.Services.Interfaces' are already imported.

In the PresenterIntegration constructor, after the other service constructions (~L118-123, near BibleDatabaseService), add: 'var templatesPath = Path.Combine(appFolder, "Templates"); TemplateService = new TemplateService(templatesPath);'. Do NOT pre-create the folder or seed built-ins; the service handles both.
In PresenterIntegration.OpenPresenterWindow(), update the _operatorWindow.SetServices(...) call (~L206-218) to pass TemplateService as the new trailing argument, matching the new parameter position.
In WorshipPlayer.Presenter\Views\OperatorWindow.xaml, add '<MenuItem Header="Templates" Click="ToolTemplates_Click" />' inside ToolsContextMenu (L193-198), after the 'CCLI Report' item.

In WorshipPlayer.Presenter\Views\OperatorWindow.xaml.cs, add a 'ToolTemplates_Click' handler next to ToolCcliReport_Click (~L1811-1828). It must: create 'var panel = new TemplateManagerPanel();' set 'if (_templateService != null) panel.TemplateService = _templateService;' host it in 'new Window { Title = "Templates", Width = 720, Height = 560, MinWidth = 480, MinHeight = 360, Background = new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#0F1117")), WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner, Owner = this, Content = panel }' and call ShowDialog(); wrap in try/catch calling ShowToolError("Templates", ex.Message). Add 'using WorshipPlayer.Presenter.Views.Templates;' if not already present.
Build the solution and fix any compile errors introduced by the signature change.
acceptance_criteria: The build command completes with 0 errors (pre-existing warnings allowed).
TemplateService is constructed exactly once in PresenterIntegration with a Path.Combine(appFolder, "Templates") folder and exposed as a public ITemplateService property.
OperatorWindow.SetServices accepts and stores the TemplateService, and OpenPresenterWindow passes it.
ToolsContextMenu contains a 'Templates' MenuItem wired to ToolTemplates_Click, which opens TemplateManagerPanel in a dialog window with panel.TemplateService set.
No manual built-in-seeding code was added (seeding stays in TemplateService.EnsureLoadedAsync).
Running the TemplateServiceTests still passes all 20 tests (no backend regression).
findings:
WIRING DONE for FEAT-002:

1. PresenterIntegration (WorshipPlayer.UI\Services\PresenterIntegration.cs): new public property 'public ITemplateService TemplateService { get; }' added to the 'Additional services' group (right after BibleDatabaseService). Constructed in ctor as: var templatesPath = Path.Combine(appFolder, "Templates"); TemplateService = new TemplateService(templatesPath);  (appFolder = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory). No folder pre-create, no manual seeding (TemplateService.EnsureLoadedAsync handles both).

2. OperatorWindow.SetServices PARAMETER ORDER (declaration in OperatorWindow.xaml.cs) is now, in order: songLibraryService, mediaLibraryService, searchService, exportService, alertService, countdownService, songUsageService, bibleProvider, serviceOrderManager, songManager, templateService. templateService (type ITemplateService?) is the LAST/trailing parameter. PresenterIntegration.OpenPresenterWindow() passes TemplateService as the final argument of the SetServices(...) call.

3. OperatorWindow field: 'private ITemplateService? _templateService;' added alongside the other service fields; assigned '_templateService = templateService;' at the end of SetServices body. Using 'WorshipPlayer.Presenter.Views.Templates;' was added to OperatorWindow.xaml.cs (ITemplateService came from the already-present WorshipPlayer.Core.Services.Interfaces).

4. Tools entry point: OperatorWindow.xaml ToolsContextMenu now has '<MenuItem Header="Templates" Click="ToolTemplates_Click" />' after the 'CCLI Report' item. Handler ToolTemplates_Click in OperatorWindow.xaml.cs (placed just before LoadCcliReportDataAsync) creates 'var panel = new TemplateManagerPanel();', sets 'panel.TemplateService = _templateService' when non-null, hosts it in a new Window (Title "Templates", 720x560, MinWidth 480, MinHeight 360, Background #0F1117, CenterOwner, Owner = this) and calls ShowDialog(); wrapped in try/catch -> ShowToolError("Templates", ex.Message). TemplateManagerPanel exposes 'public ITemplateService? TemplateService' setter which auto-refreshes.

TemplateService ctor signature: public TemplateService(string templatesFolder). ITemplateService (WorshipPlayer.Core.Services.Interfaces) is fully async CRUD: GetAllAsync, GetByIdAsync, GetByCategoryAsync, CreateAsync, UpdateAsync, DeleteAsync(returns bool), DuplicateAsync(id,newName), GetBuiltInTemplatesAsync, ApplyToItemAsync(templateId,itemId).

Verification: build = 0 errors (4 pre-existing warnings only); TemplateServiceTests = 20/20 passed.
